question: Where can I find hotel that lies within 100 kilometers en route to Bailey Park, Somers, NY from New York Institute of Technology, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New York Institute of Technology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Bailey Park%' AND ST_Intersects( geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Somers%' AND border_type = 'administrative' LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 100000 -- 100 kilometers in meters ) );
